application.title: Support360
application.description: Support ticketing platform for employees to raise issues and support agents/admins to track, assign and resolve tickets with full audit history.

navigation.title: Ticket Management
navigation.description: Employee-facing ticket creation and self-service tracking
navigation.functional_specs: Group for Employee ticket creation and My Tickets tracking

navigation.title: My Tickets
navigation.description: Employee logs a new support ticket
navigation.functional_specs: Header-only transaction to create/edit/delete a support ticket with TICKET_NO (auto), TITLE, DESCRIPTION, CATEGORY_CODE, PRIORITY_CODE, STATUS (default Open, read-only), RAISED_BY (VARCHAR(36), mandatory, read-only, visible on the form, auto-populated at runtime with the currently logged-in user's user id), RAISED_BY_NAME (VARCHAR(100), read-only, display-only, not a persisted business input, resolved via business logic at ticket creation from the logged-in user's id (RAISED_BY) to their display name and shown alongside RAISED_BY), CREATED_DATE, ATTACHMENT. Mandatory: TITLE, DESCRIPTION, CATEGORY_CODE (active Category master), PRIORITY_CODE (active Priority master). Actions: Add, Edit (before assignment), Delete (own ticket while Open), Search. Attachment linked with uploaded-by/uploaded-date. Writes Created entry to Activity/History Log. Inline validation and success messages. The Assign Agent action opens the Ticket Assignment (support360_ticket_assignment) transaction screen for the current ticket. CATEGORY_NAME (VARCHAR(100), read-only, non-editable) is auto-filled from SUPPORT360_CATEGORY_MASTER.CATEGORY_NAME when CATEGORY_CODE is selected. PRIORITY_NAME (VARCHAR(100), read-only, non-editable) is auto-filled from SUPPORT360_PRIORITY_MASTER.PRIORITY_NAME when PRIORITY_CODE is selected. Both are display-only fields shown next to their respective code fields and are not persisted business inputs. Once the ticket's STATUS is Closed, this screen shows it fully read-only — no field edit, attachment, comment, or status/assignment action is permitted.

navigation.title: Resolved Tickets
navigation.description: Employee view of own tickets marked Resolved by the Support Agent
navigation.functional_specs: Row-level restricted to RAISED_BY = current Employee, fixed filter STATUS = Resolved. Lists TICKET_NO, TITLE, CATEGORY_CODE, PRIORITY_CODE, STATUS, ASSIGNED_AGENT, CREATED_DATE, CHG_DATE; drill-in shows DESCRIPTION, ATTACHMENT, AGENT_COMMENTS, RESOLUTION_NOTES, ACTIVITY_HISTORY. Add/Edit/Delete are disabled. Actions: Close Ticket (STATUS -> Closed, stamps CLOSED_DATE/CLOSED_BY) and Reopen Ticket (STATUS -> In Progress), both only valid while STATUS = Resolved. The ticket record can be edited by the Employee while STATUS remains Resolved; editing is blocked once the ticket is Closed or Reopened.

navigation.title: Agent Ticket Desk
navigation.description: Support Agent queue management and resolution workflow
navigation.functional_specs: Group for Support Agent ticket queue handling

navigation.title: Manage Ticket Queue
navigation.description: Agent views, works, and resolves tickets
navigation.functional_specs: Actionable tickets: STATUS in (Open, Assigned, In Progress) that are unassigned or assigned to current Agent. Data: TICKET_NO, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, CATEGORY_CODE, PRIORITY_CODE, STATUS, RAISED_BY, ASSIGNED_AGENT, CREATED_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_DATE, ATTACHMENT list, COMMENT list, RESOLUTION_NOTES. Status flow Open->Assigned->In Progress->Resolved->Closed. STATUS dropdown on Edit offers only Start Progress (In Progress) and Resolved; Assigned is not user-selectable. RESOLUTION_NOTES mandatory before Resolve. Actions: Search, Filter (STATUS, PRIORITY_CODE, CATEGORY_CODE, ASSIGNED_AGENT), Edit, Start-progress, Add-comment, Add-attachment, Resolve. Every change writes a timestamped Activity/History Log entry with old/new value and changed-by. A read-only Assigned To column displays the assigned agent's AGENT_NAME (looked up from SUPPORT360_AGENT), not just the agent code. Support Agents can directly edit ticket fields via the standard Edit action, in addition to the Start Progress/Add Comment/Add Attachment/Resolve actions. Assignment of the Support Agent is not performed on this screen; it happens on the separate Ticket Assignment (support360_ticket_assignment) screen. STATUS transitions are strictly validated on this screen: a ticket may move from Assigned to In Progress (shown in the Status drop-down as "Start Progress"), and from In Progress to Resolved. A ticket whose STATUS is Open cannot be set directly to In Progress or Resolved — it must first be Assigned (via Ticket Assignment or the Assign action). Any other STATUS change (same-value, backwards, or skipping a stage) is blocked with an inline error stating the current and attempted status. Start Progress action also allows STATUS to move from Reopen to In Progress (in addition to Assigned to In Progress); Resolve action (In Progress to Resolved) is unchanged, so a Reopen ticket can now be progressed Reopen -> In Progress -> Resolved by the Support Agent. Once the ticket's STATUS is Closed, this screen shows it fully read-only — no field edit, attachment, comment, or status/assignment action is permitted. Once STATUS = Closed, the ticket becomes fully read-only on this screen — no field may be edited. A read-only Raised By column displays the ticket raiser's resolved display name (RAISED_BY_NAME on SUPPORT360_TICKET), not the raw RAISED_BY user id.

navigation.title: Admin Setup
navigation.description: Master data and overarching ticket administration
navigation.functional_specs: Group for Category/Priority master maintenance and full ticket administration

navigation.title: Manage Category Master
navigation.description: Admin defines and maintains ticket categories
navigation.functional_specs: Master with CATEGORY_CODE, CATEGORY_NAME, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE. CATEGORY_CODE and CATEGORY_NAME mandatory and unique. Cannot delete if referenced by any ticket; can only be deactivated in that case. Actions: Search, Add, Edit, Delete (only if unused), Activate/Deactivate.

navigation.title: Manage Priority Master
navigation.description: Admin defines and maintains priority levels
navigation.functional_specs: Master with PRIORITY_CODE, PRIORITY_NAME, SEQUENCE_NO, IS_ACTIVE. PRIORITY_CODE, PRIORITY_NAME, SEQUENCE_NO mandatory; PRIORITY_CODE and SEQUENCE_NO unique. Cannot delete if referenced by any ticket; can only be deactivated in that case. Actions: Search, Add, Edit, Delete (only if unused), Activate/Deactivate.

navigation.title: Manage Agent Master
navigation.description: Admin maintains the master list of Support Agents with their availability and status.
navigation.functional_specs: Header-only transaction screen to create/edit agent records. Fields: AGENT_ID (VARCHAR(20), editable, mandatory, unique identifier for the agent), AGENT_NAME (VARCHAR(100), editable, mandatory), AGENT_AVAILABILITY (VARCHAR(20), dropdown single-select, allowed values Available/Occupied, mandatory), AGENT_STATUS (VARCHAR(20), dropdown single-select, allowed values Active/Inactive, mandatory). Business actions: Add, Edit, Search.

navigation.title: Manage Ticket Assignment
navigation.description: Agent assigns the Support Agent handling a ticket; only Active agents are listed, and only Active + Available agents may be assigned
navigation.functional_specs: Header-only transaction on main_table SUPPORT360_TICKET, PK TICKET_NO. Fields: TICKET_NO (VARCHAR(30), read-only), TITLE (VARCHAR(200), read-only), ASSIGNED_AGENT (VARCHAR(36), editable, lookup to SUPPORT360_AGENT.AGENT_ID where AGENT_STATUS=Active), STATUS (VARCHAR(20), read-only). Opened for a specific ticket from the Create Support Ticket screen's Assign Agent action, passing TICKET_NO as context. Action: Save (update ASSIGNED_AGENT). Once the ticket's STATUS is Closed, this screen shows it fully read-only — no field edit, attachment, comment, or status/assignment action is permitted. Screen is editable only when the ticket's STATUS = Open; for any other STATUS the ticket is view-only and Assigned Agent cannot be changed. ASSIGNED_AGENT and REASSIGN_TO_AGENT remain editable while STATUS is not Closed; once STATUS = Closed, the ticket becomes fully read-only on this screen and these fields may no longer be edited. When STATUS = Closed, the entire screen is view-only: ASSIGNED_AGENT and all fields are non-editable and no assign/reassign action can be taken; all other statuses remain editable as currently specified. Tickets with STATUS = In Progress are also fully read-only on this screen (Assigned Agent protected, Save hidden, save blocked), the same treatment as Closed tickets. Assigned Agent lookup shows only agents with AGENT_STATUS = Active (Inactive agents are excluded). Active agents with AGENT_AVAILABILITY = Occupied are still shown in the list but cannot be selected or saved — selecting/saving an Occupied agent is blocked with a validation error; only Active + Available agents can be assigned.

navigation.title: Dashboards
navigation.functional_specs: Group for Employee, Support Agent and Admin dashboards

navigation.title: Admin Dashboard
navigation.functional_specs: Dashboard for Admin role. Criteria: CREATED_DATE range default current month (adjustable), CATEGORY_CODE (optional). Composes Total Open Tickets Count (Card), Total Resolved This Period Count (Card), Ticket Count by Status (Column-Chart), Ticket Count by Priority (Pie-Chart), Tickets by Status Trend (Stacked-Column-Chart). All visuals drill to All Tickets filtered by clicked STATUS/PRIORITY_CODE/date bucket.
